sections.title: Where you are now
paras: You are now in the period of Jupiter (main period, 15 November 2023 – 15 November 2039) and inside it the sub-period of Saturn, which lasts until 15 July 2028.

Jupiter stands for wisdom, children, teachers, wealth and faith; Saturn stands for hard work, delays, discipline, servants and old age. So these are the matters that come up most in your life right now.
In your chart these planets touch: wealth, savings, family; enemies, disease, debts.
This is a mixed time: some things move, some get stuck. Go step by step.
On 15 July 2028 the sub-period changes to Mercury – the overall feel stays much the same.

sections.title: This year (2026)
paras: 2026 is, overall, a challenging year for you.
Going well: Home, mother & property; Expenses, travel abroad & sleep.
Saturn's Dhaiya (Ashtama – 8th from the Moon) is running: about two and a half years of extra pressure – slower progress, more responsibility, and the need to look after health. Saturn remedies help.

sections.title: The next six months
paras: Go slow and avoid big risks in: Dec 2026, Feb 2027, Mar 2027, Apr 2027.

items.text: Health & vitality – needs attention now. The main planet behind it is Saturn, which sits in your Tanu bhav (self, body, health, personality, overall direction of life).
Money & income – needs attention now. The main planet behind it is Jupiter, which sits in your Dhana bhav (wealth, savings, family, speech, food, early education).
Children – keep an eye on it. The main planet behind it is Jupiter, which sits in your Putra bhav (children, intelligence, learning, mantra, creativity, past-life merit, speculation).

sections.title: What to do – simple remedies

plans.why: Why Saturn: it is linked to “Health & vitality” right now. Its remedies aim to calm it down.
steps: Mantra: every day, or at least every Saturday, say “Om Praam Preem Praum Sah Shanaye Namah” 108 times (ॐ प्रां प्रीं प्रौं सः शनये नमः).
Prayer: Dasharatha's Shani Stotra and Hanuman Chalisa on Saturdays
Give (daana): black sesame, mustard oil, iron, black blanket · Saturday evening, to labourers, the elderly, the disabled or the poor
Lal Kitab quick remedy: Feed black dogs or crows with mustard-oil-applied roti.
Daily habit: Be punctual, honest and patient; treat servants and workers fairly; avoid alcohol and meat (at least on Saturdays).
Temple visit (when possible): Darbaranyeswarar (Saneeswaran) Temple, Thirunallar, Puducherry – best on Saturday; Shani Peyarchi.
Do NOT wear this planet's gem (Blue sapphire (Neelam)) – it would make the problem stronger.

plans.why: Why Jupiter: it is linked to “Money & income” right now. Its remedies aim to calm it down.
steps: Mantra: every day, or at least every Thursday, say “Om Graam Greem Graum Sah Gurave Namah” 108 times (ॐ ग्रां ग्रीं ग्रौं सः गुरवे नमः).
Prayer: Vishnu Sahasranama or Guru Stotra on Thursdays; Dakshinamurthy Stotram
Give (daana): chana dal, turmeric, yellow cloth, books to students · Thursday morning, to teachers, priests or scholars
Lal Kitab quick remedy: Apply saffron or turmeric tilak on the forehead and navel.
Daily habit: Respect teachers, priests and elders; teach what you know; avoid arrogance; apply a saffron or turmeric tilak.
Temple visit (when possible): Apatsahayesvarar Temple, Alangudi, Tamil Nadu – best on Thursday; Guru Peyarchi.

paras: Pick one or two of these and do them regularly for 40 days. Doing a little every day works better than doing a lot once.

sections.title: Good days to begin
paras: Start your remedies on one of these days: 24 November 2026 (Tuesday), 12 December 2026 (Saturday), 20 December 2026 (Sunday).

sections.title: Health tip
paras: By tradition, your chart asks you to take extra care of: heart, spine. Regular check-ups are a good idea – this is not a medical diagnosis.

closing: Astrology shows tendencies, not fixed fate. Your own effort, good conduct and sensible decisions matter most. For the full detail behind this summary, open the other reports.
